topic.label: Mapping
topic.desc: Mapping: map types, dimensions, coordinate systems, survey methods, SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping), spatial data and web mapping.

concepts: Kinds of map: topographic, thematic, road network, indoor and occupancy maps.
Mapping in two, two-and-a-half, three and four dimensions.
Datums, coordinate reference systems and map projections.
How spatial data is captured: GNSS and RTK, photogrammetry, LiDAR scanning and remote sensing.
Building a map of an unknown place while estimating the sensor's own position in it, with visual and LiDAR methods.
Spatial file formats, queries and cartographic design.
Geocoding, map tiles and routing services for web and mobile maps.
skills: Chooses map type, scale and symbology for a purpose and builds thematic maps from attribute data.
Builds a routable road network graph with turn restrictions and speed attributes and checks connectivity.
Builds indoor floor plans and occupancy grids from scans or sensor data and marks unknown space explicitly.
Builds elevation and surface models from points or imagery and separates ground from objects.
Filters, registers and meshes three-dimensional point clouds and reports density and noise.
Compares maps or scans from different dates to find real change and separates it from registration error.
Transforms coordinates between datums and projections and reports the expected error of each transformation.
Selects a projection for a region and purpose by which distortion matters, such as area, distance or shape.
Plans GNSS and RTK surveys with base station setup, occupation time and ground control points and reports accuracy.
Plans image capture and processing for a three-dimensional model with overlap, camera calibration and check points.
Plans terrestrial, mobile or airborne LiDAR scans for point density and coverage and notes occlusions.
Works with satellite and aerial imagery for land cover, change and indices and states resolution limits.
Estimates camera motion and builds a sparse or dense map from monocular, stereo or depth images using features and keyframes, and states the scale ambiguity of a single camera.
Registers successive LiDAR scans into a map and a trajectory with scan matching and optional inertial data.
Loop Closure and Pose Graph Optimization
Detects revisited places and optimizes the pose graph to remove accumulated drift, rejecting false loop closures.
Evaluates a SLAM run against ground truth with absolute and relative trajectory error and map accuracy.
Converts between GeoJSON, shapefile, GeoTIFF and GeoPackage and reports attributes or precision lost in conversion.
Runs overlay, buffer, join and proximity analysis on layers and explains the result with its caveats.
Designs a legible map layout with labels, color and legend for a stated audience.
Converts addresses to coordinates and back and returns the match quality of each result.
Prepares vector or raster tiles and a basemap style for web display and sets zoom levels and caching.
Integrates a routing service for directions and travel times and tests edge cases such as closures and one-way streets.

Map and analyze your geospatial data
TomTom maps, routing, geocoding & traffic data
